title: Maximum Number of Occurrences of a Substring
goal: Find the greatest frequency of an allowed repeated substring.
strategy: Only minSize needs counting: any longer valid substring has a valid minSize prefix appearing at least as often. Slide a fixed-length frequency window, counting text keys only when their distinct-letter count fits the limit.
